//overrides: Next 15.5.25 ships its own nested copy of postcss 8.4.x, which carries four
advisories (the sourceMappingURL path-traversal chain and the </style> XSS).
npm's only offered fix was next@16 — a second major upgrade for one nested
dependency. postcss 8.4 to 8.5 is a minor with no API break, so forcing the
nested copy up is the smaller change. Verified against a production build.
Revisit when moving to Next 16, at which point this override can be deleted.
The rest force patched copies of packages we only get second-hand, each one
still inside the range its parent already asks for, so no parent changes:
sharp          <- next, optional (^0.35.4) librsvg CVE, fixed in 0.35.5
dompurify      <- jspdf, optional (^3.3.1) two IN_PLACE XSS, fixed in 3.4.16
Not overridden: postcss-selector-parser. Its fix is 7.x and tailwind 3 asks
for ^6, and it only ever parses our own CSS at build time. Revisit with
